title: The Sleeping Hymn
author: Xanthe Galloway
blurb: Marguerite Amberdale, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
